notes.title: Update note for August 15
notes.notes: Fixed an issue with existing achievements for players who played the original game before playing Super Hiking League DX.

notes.title: Super Hiking League DX Update!
notes.notes:
The wait is almost over! Super Hiking League DX is coming as an update to Super Hiking League and brings many improvements. Check out the list below!

New major features in Super Hiking League DX:
- Easy difficulty added to Arcade mode!
- Brand new 27 stages, unlockable by completing arcade mode in different difficulty settings!
- 2 new easier rope modes: Automatic and Mixed!
- Watch your own replays or the Hike Master's in Time Attack mode!

Other improvements:
- Fairer AI for the easier difficulty settings.
- Reworked rope bending code.
- Alternate character colors (select with the "start" button or the "enter" key).
- Both players may now select the same character.
- Several other small improvements and fixes.

This major update is set to hit Steam on August 10th, 2021.

notes.title: Super Hiking League 1.0.0.2 update!
notes.notes:
This update comes with a new small feature for speedrunners: now you can quickly restart on time attack mode! Use down + esc/enter when playing on the keyboard, or down + back/start when playing on the gamepad (please note that some gamepad models may not be compatible).

1.0.0.2 Update Summary:
new feature: added shortcut for quick restart on timeattack mode.

improvement: added a short minimum time for firing the rope multiple times in sequence.
improvement: improved "unlocked text" animation and interaction in Arcade Mode.
improvement: added skippable Arcade mode intro option only after it's been seen at least once (esc/back).

bugfix: fixed bug where in certain conditions you could pick the same character for both players.
bugfix: Master of Combat and Fastest of All achievements now working properly (please beat the AI on Master difficulty on any Stage to activate it if you've already beaten all of them).
bugfix: in rare cases the unlock text would show the wrong message.
